rules.interaction: State law; no local override stated.
rules.title: Fair Chance in Housing Act
rules.requirement: Landlords may not ask about criminal history on an application or before a conditional offer. After the offer they may only consider certain recent convictions, must do an individualized assessment, and must give written reasons if they withdraw the offer.
rules.key_value: No criminal-record inquiry before conditional offer; lookback 6 years (1st degree), 4 years (2nd/3rd degree), 1 year (4th degree); penalties up to $1,000/$5,000/$10,000
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers offering a rental dwelling unit for residential purposes
rules.exemptions: Dwelling unit in an owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units
rules.quoted_span: regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.
